supervisor: launch.py, mostly idle; holds common native-owner mutex and accounts child CPU
attempt_policy: new root only; no overwrite, resume, shrinkage, seed extension or automatic scientific retry
data_layout: 128 seed JSONL parts per phase, 64 groups and 1536 policy rows per seed

profile.kind: first complete formal seed is preserved as the science prefix; no duplicate profile trajectories
profile.overrun_projection: stop, preserve prefix, ask for new direction; never shrink

accounting.preparation_tests: all attempt process CPU, including failed non-scientific test attempts
accounting.measured_native: supervisor process CPU plus exact worker process CPU from Windows GetProcessTimes

analysis.paired_bootstrap: 128 independent seeds, 2000 resamples with analysis seed20579901; families macro-averaged within seed before aggregate intervals
analysis.directional_error_check: unique seed/family/regime/learner probe decisions, not duplicated by budget or policy

handoff: hourly existing heartbeat checks readiness and launches automatically once all locked prerequisites pass; no separate watcher or competing worker
final_audit: supervisor read-back after worker exit verifies complete counts, hashes, semantic replay and double-analysis equality; plot visual review is separately recorded by the agent
